definition: Irfan Aziz Essa is a professor in the School of Interactive Computing of the College of Computing, and adjunct professor in the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech).
details: He is an associate dean in Georgia Tech's College of Computing and the director of the new Interdisciplinary Research Center for Machine Learning at Georgia Tech (ML@GT).

explainer.lead: Irfan Essa is an American academic.

timeline.what: Essa obtained his undergraduate degree in engineering at the Illinois Institute of Technology in 1988.
Following this, Essa attended the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he received his magister scientiae (Master of Science) in 1990 and his Ph.D. in 1995 at the MIT Media Lab.
He proceeded to hold a position as a research scientist at MIT from 1994 to 1996 before accepting a position at Georgia Tech.
He is credited, alongside his doctoral student Nick Diakopoulos, with coining the term computational journalism back in 2006, when they taught the first class on the subject.
In addition to this, Essa has organized the Computational Journalism Symposium both in 2008 and 2013.
In the spring of 2013, Essa taught a free online course on computational photography, on the MOOC platform Coursera.
